name: disk-hygiene
description: Context-aware disk hygiene for arbitrary directory trees: inventories orphaned and temporary artifacts, classifies evidence into review tiers, and offers exact-path cleanup only after a fresh safety preview and explicit per-tier approval. The target is read-only by default; OS-managed paths, links and mount points, VCS-tracked content without the complete checkout evidence bundle, changed entries, and live-handle uncertainty fail closed.

disk_hygiene_enabled.title: Clean execution tiers
disk_hygiene_enabled.description: Allows the clean skill's execution tiers. On by default; false is audit-only mode.

policy_file.title: Personal policy file
policy_file.description: Absolute path to your own policy overlay (JSON, the clean skill's policy-overlay schema), layered under the repository's docs/conventions/disk-hygiene.yaml. The only standing layer that may set elevation to uac-prompt. Empty means no personal policy file.
